statement: An order refused because an event is open passes once the event is answered: retry it within hours and never store it as a refusal of the order itself.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 source run (23 Nov): one air_superiority order refused with events_open was kept as a refusal of the region; 9 fighter wings (900 planes) trained all winter
three war runs (22-23 Nov): events_open refusals of air_mission 13, air_rebase 10, construction_add 2, army_offensive 1
checked: the ledger's passing_failure list has no events_open; only the air plan lane treats it as transient

executor.advice: answer the open events, then send the order again

statement: An order refused because the selection was lost (another click took it) is not a refusal of the order: retry it soon.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (s53a, 23 Nov): the air lane had stored such refusals as refusals of the region and left wings training; its fix covers the air lane only
checked: the ledger's passing_failure list has no selection_lost; only the air plan lane treats it as transient

executor.advice: send the order again; nothing about it was wrong

statement: A rebase to a full air base is refused every time: send the wing to the nearest base with room instead (hoi4_air_regions lists each base's free capacity).
evidence: Germany campaign and West beds (22-23 Nov): hoi4_air_rebase refused air_base_full 16 times, the same base asked again
checked: no executor lane handles air_base_full; only the tool itself reports it

executor.advice: rebase to the nearest base with room; the full base will not take it

statement: A production line for equipment the country cannot build yet (research not done, or a ship hull on military factories) is refused until that changes: wait for the research instead of re-adding the line every few days.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (g17n, g17o): production_add ship_hull_submarine_1 refused 17 times, every one or two weeks; six dockyards idle meanwhile
checked: the ledger treats invalid_target as final only for focus starts; production orders rest the standard span

executor.advice: the equipment needs its research first: queue the research or pick a researched equipment

statement: When no trait of a general can be picked, the refusal holds until he gains a level: do not ask again within weeks.
evidence: Germany 1939-40: 11 tries for two generals, 0 traits; every answer was 'No assignable trait can be picked now'
checked: the seams lane skips the general on this code; the generic ledger (other lanes, the player) does not

executor.advice: spend the command power elsewhere; the general needs a level first

statement: Design companies and their slots are not politics options: hoi4_politics_options refuses them with use_mio_tools; read and assign them with hoi4_mios and hoi4_mio_line.
evidence: three runs (22-23 Nov): hoi4_politics_options refused use_mio_tools 51 times
checked: no executor lane names use_mio_tools; the read is repeated on every politics pass

executor.advice: use hoi4_mios for designers and design companies

statement: A template edit for a template name the game does not have is refused every time: read hoi4_division_templates for the exact name first.
evidence: three runs (22-23 Nov): hoi4_template_edit refused template_unknown 11 times
checked: the generic ledger rests it as any other refusal

executor.advice: read the exact template names with hoi4_division_templates

statement: A construction order refused with building_select_failed did not reach the game's building button (a GUI fault of that building on this version), not a reason to give up the state: report it as a tool fault.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (s53a): radar stations in states 51 and 56 blocked after 3 tries each, building_select_failed; 12 such refusals in three runs
checked: the plan item is blocked after three tries; nothing tells the gate it is the tool

executor.advice: a tool fault for this building: report it; build other buildings meanwhile

statement: hoi4_event_choose takes the option as its index (0, 1, ...), not the option's key or name.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (g17n): option given as the key string 'germany.14.a' 18 times, refused invalid_arguments; 0 passed
checked: the tool refuses a key; nothing tells the player before the call

statement: When an event answer reads back still open, another event is drawn over it: answer the event on top first (the list order is not the screen order).
evidence: news.234 answered 5 times and still open (s53a); mtg_netherlands.66 x17, news.33 x10 in the audit
checked: the executor iterates the events from the last; the player has no such rule

statement: hoi4_decisions_list and hoi4_special_projects take no `full` argument: call them without it.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (g17n): both tools refused `full` at the player's setup reads
checked: the tools refuse unknown arguments

statement: hoi4_politics_options needs `category` as a string (and `slot`): a call without it is refused.
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (g17n): 5 calls without a category refused; the audit counts 48 such faults
checked: the schema requires category

statement: hoi4_research_start without a free slot is refused unless `replace` is set: read hoi4_research for a free slot first.
evidence: the audit counts 62 research_start calls without a free slot (18-23 Nov)
checked: the tool refuses; the player retried

statement: hoi4_air_mission's region is the strategic region's id as the game reads it (hoi4_air_regions lists them); a wrong form is refused.
evidence: the audit counts 30 air_mission calls refused for the region's form
checked: the schema leaves the type open

statement: hoi4_states needs `query` (a country tag, a name or ids): an empty call is refused.
evidence: the audit counts 34 hoi4_states {} calls
checked: the schema requires query

statement: An army that belongs to a running operation refuses direct orders (owned_by_operation): change the operation in the plan, or take the army out of it, instead of ordering it by hand.
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): a hand front for the stalled group was refused owned_by_operation; the operation had to be edited
checked: the server refuses before input; the player is not told what to do instead

statement: hoi4_save is refused while an event is open: answer the open events first, then save.
evidence: the audit counts 14 saves refused with events_open (52 of 117 saves failed)
checked: the save flow refuses; nothing answers the events for it

statement: Saving while paused in the naval map mode fails: the save clicks fall through onto the map. Switch to the default map mode (hoi4_map_mode) before hoi4_save, and retry a failed save once.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): 14 of 27 saves failed; a screenshot showed the North Sea region panel open and the map in the naval mode under the save clicks
checked: the save flow does not set the map mode

statement: An attack from one province engages only what the combat width holds (4 of 23 divisions engaged in a forest battle, 19 in reserve): spread the attackers over the neighbouring provinces of the front and attack the same target from several.
evidence: West bed (23 Nov, battle read): Armee Pommern attacked a Belgian forest province with 23 divisions, 4 engaged, 19 in reserve
checked: no executor rule spreads an attacking stack by the combat width

statement: A front piece too short for its divisions overstacks: supply and organisation fall before the enemy is met. Give a large formation a front with enough provinces for its divisions (63 divisions on a 4-province border ran at 21-30% supply).
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): Army Group 2, 63 divisions on the 4-province Belgian border, supply 21-30%, organisation 49-61%, BEL held all its states for six months
West beds (23 Nov): 19-23 divisions in one Groningen/Rhineland province at 50-57% supply
checked: the stacking finding names it; no rule widens a front

plan_lint.text: a group front from a single own state is a short piece for a whole group: check it is long enough for its divisions

statement: A spear line must run through a small country to a target beyond it: a line of one state stops at that state and does not carry the armour to the victory points.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): with the line [Luxembourg] alone Luxembourg was never taken (0/5 VP although its army died); with the line through Luxembourg to the states beyond it fell on day 4
checked: the operation follows the plan's target_line as written

plan_lint.text: a one-state target line stops the formation at that state: run it through to a target beyond

statement: A wing alone against a defended border with allied divisions behind it bleeds and takes nothing: keep the assault guard on for a wing; the border falls to the main weight.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): without the guard Armee Pommern (23 div) attacked Belgium alone at 1:0.91 and Moselland was lost; with it the Belgians bled 1:2.4 against the held front
checked: the guard exists in the operation; nothing stops a plan from turning it off

plan_lint.text: the assault guard is off: a wing alone against a defended border bled in the West beds

statement: Draw the attacking fronts weeks before the declaration: a front drawn or redrawn days before has no planning bonus and its first battles are fought without it.
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): the Low Countries front drawn in late April after a rename, war on 11 May: no planning bonus at W day
West beds (23 Nov): the group's planning 0.43 in April fell to 0.24 at war after redraws
checked: the operation prepares from its prepare date; nothing reports planning at the declaration

statement: When an enemy capitulates, every army that fought it needs a new front within days; left without one it stands where the war ended (63 divisions at Lublin for 3.5 months).
evidence: Germany 1939-40 (g17n): Army Group 2 stood at Lublin with no front from October to January after Poland capitulated
checked: the operation's hand-over moves formations it names; armies outside it get nothing

statement: After an enemy capitulates its air regions empty: send every land-mission wing over it to the next front the same week.
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): 11 fighter wings flew air superiority over pacified Western Poland in January; the plan's West air rows started in late April
checked: the air plan follows its dated rows; nothing reacts to a capitulation

statement: A strike objective of a finished operation must not stay on an army of the next one (an armoured group sat in Slovakia for 256 days on a Polish province).
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): Panzergruppe Ost stood in western Slovakia with a Polish strike objective 256 days old on the day the West began
checked: reported as an executor gap; the monitor's packet carries it until a rule exists

statement: Holland floods its water line (an event) when its core is not taken in the first days: the armour must be on the Dutch border at the declaration, not on its way.
evidence: Germany 1940 (g17n): the armour was in Bohemia and Slovakia on W day; Holland flooded and held 4 of 5 states for six months
checked: country-specific fact; no rule names it

statement: A defended border with allied divisions behind it is not taken by a wing: put the main weight (the group and the armour) on it, from the side where the defence is thinnest.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): Belgium held 0 of 86 points in every 28-day run while the group and both armour corps fought in Holland or the Ardennes
checked: the plan decides the weight; no rule moves it

statement: A formation that stood on its front long enough to reach its planning bonus takes a small neighbour in days at a high ratio (Luxembourg in 4 days, 1:90 and 1:33).
evidence: West beds w53a and w53c (23 Nov): the armour fronted on Luxembourg since October at planning 0.40 took it on day 4
checked: a judgement for plans; no rule

statement: When an executing operation sends no army order for days, its formations are waiting on a guard, a hand-over or an order that keeps failing: read the operation's last status lines, not the map.
evidence: West bed w53a (23 Nov): no army order from war day 0 to about day 9 (declarations, air, MIO and doctrine only)
checked: the monitor's war_orders_silent rule finds it; no executor rule reports it

statement: An attack across a river fights at a penalty: when the battle read shows one, move the arrow to a province without the river or bring the armour to it, rather than paying the losses.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): HOL ratios 1:1.7-1:3.4 and the Dutch canal line held from day 14 in every run
checked: general game mechanics; the executor attacks the target line as written

statement: Two failed saves in a row are a tool fault for the gate, not something to retry every minute: answer events, close panels, switch to the default map mode, retry once, then report.
evidence: 22-23 Nov: 14 of 27 saves in the West runs and 52 of 117 overall failed (input_readback_failed 35, events_open 14, window closed 10)
checked: the save flow retries internally; nothing reports a failing streak

statement: Executing a battle plan after every redraw repeats the same order: draw all fronts and arrows of a formation first, then execute once.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): 22-34 identical repeats per 38 days, most of them army_plan execute after each redraw (PG Nord / Army Group 1 x3-6)
checked: the war step executes after each order it sends; nothing batches the execute

statement: An offensive sent one state at a time repeats the order for each state: send the formation's whole target line in one hoi4_army_offensive call with `states`.
evidence: West beds (23 Nov): offensives sent state by state (West Sud to 35 x3, PG Ost to 34 x4); 39 single-state calls against 20 with states
checked: the tool takes `states`; the war step still sends single states in several paths

statement: An army that holds a border must not be listed in an attack group: the group's regroup takes it and the border it held falls.
evidence: Germany 1939 (bed c41d, 23 Nov): the Westwall hold army joined the Polish group, its hold front kept 0 divisions and France took three border states
checked: the regroup was fixed for armies outside the plan group; a plan can still list a hold army in a group
